newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ's Moore accepts Labour trade role.
newsitem.headline: NZ's Moore accepts Labour trade role.

text.p: Former Labour leader Mike Moore said on Wednesday he had accepted an offer to be Labour's spokesman on foreign affairs and trade.
His acceptance was welcomed by Labour leader Helen Clark.
A spokesman for Clark said the decision "effectively buries the hatchet and settles the differences that have simmered (in the party) for some time".
